statement: A sequence is defined by $u_{1}=1$ and $u_{n+1}=\\frac{u_{n}}{1+u_{n}}$ for $n\\ge 1$. (i) Show that $\\frac{1}{u_{n+1}}=\\frac{1}{u_{n}}+1$. (ii) Hence find a closed form for $u_{n}$. (iii) Show that $u_{n}\\to 0$ as $n\\to\\infty$.
hints: Look at the reciprocal of the recurrence.
